messages:
jules: tiny a11y pass on the run-details/presets flow — keyboard focus ends up on an invisible helper after hitting Save. keyboard users effectively lose the focus target.
maria: thanks. can you paste the steps to repro?
jules: open Run -> Presets -> Edit -> Save. After saving the visual focus disappears even though VoiceOver reads a note. looks like we're focusing the sr-helper instead of a visible element.
chris: yeah we've been programmatically focusing a hidden node to trigger announcements. that pattern causes visible focus gap.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) no programmatic focus on purely decorative live nodes; 2) visible focus ring on preset pills; 3) preset badge contrast >= AA for small text; 4) return focus to a meaningful element after modal flows.
sam: plan: keep announcement in aria-live (role/status) so it is read, but move actual focus to the updated preset row (make tabindex="-1" then focus()). also ensure the toast doesnt steal focus.
maria: also revert the earlier CSS that removed outlines from .pill:focus — we need a clear, high-contrast visible indicator. prefer a 2px inset border or shadow that meets contrast.
jules: color note: current badge color in light/dim drops to ~3.8:1 for label text. we should pick a darker token for text or slightly darker bg.
sam: i'll run contrast checks and attach results to the PR. proposing --brand-600 bg + #0b0b0b text to hit >4.5:1.
chris: ARIA nit: the presets list uses role=list but items don't include aria-posinset/aria-setsize. add those so SR users know their index/total in the list.
a11y-bot: keyboard test cases: open modal -> tab through controls -> save -> focus returned to updated item; arrow keys navigate preset list when focused; Esc closes dialog and restores focus.
maria: please add unit/integration tests: axe baseline and a keyboard script that asserts focus return.
jules: small copy: keep toast concise ("Preset saved"), rely on focus return for context rather than verbose toasts.
chris: ok i'll open a PR: changes will be 1) stop focusing hidden sr nodes; 2) keep role/status announcement container; 3) focus updated row after render; 4) restore focus styles on pills; 5) update badge tokens and add contrast screenshots.
sam: i'll include VoiceOver/TalkBack notes and a screenshot diff.
a11y-bot: post-merge: run SR smoke on iOS/Android.
maria: thanks everyone, small fixes but big UX improvement for keyboard and screen reader users. :thumbsup:
